data.text: I’m on board. I commit to harvesting 15 tons today and donating the $15,000 proceeds directly to the clinic. Our neighbors need treatment, and this plan leaves the lake able to recover. I’ll limit my catch to 6 tons next month, then 10 tons a month once the lake is back at 100. Let’s record the catches and donations together so we can keep each other accountable. Jack, will you join us on those terms?
